narrative: Two of three Ary-Latin misses are recovered by Ary-Arabic; the third remains a miss in Ary-Arabic and Arabic but is recovered by French. The issue is broader than pure script transliteration.
normalization_note: The tested lightweight normalization produced no Recall@5 improvement on this gold set; it changed only one of eight queries, so the evidence is limited.
